text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen. Though she initially flew 
under the radar, Kitasan Black enters the 
race after earning an impressive 3rd place 
in the fan vote.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And voted number one in the fan poll was 
Gold Ship. Now is the time to challenge 
the "Unsinkable Battleship" standing in 
her way!
